label: DeepSeek
notes: Billing is based on the total number of input and output tokens.
Fees are deducted from a user's topped-up or granted balance, with granted balances being used first.
DeepSeek supports context caching, offering a significantly reduced price for cached input tokens (cache hits).
The input cache hit price for all models was reduced to 1/10 of the original launch price as of 2026/04/26.
The model names `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` are deprecated and are now aliases for the `deepseek-v4-flash` model.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.notes: This model is offered at a 75% discount until 2026/05/31 15:59 UTC. The discounted prices are $0.003625/1M cached input tokens, $0.435/1M input tokens, and $0.87/1M output tokens.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.notes: The deprecated model names `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` correspond to the non-thinking and thinking modes of this model, respectively.
